SELECT table_name,
       bool_or(column_name = 'company_id') AS tem_company,
       bool_or(column_name = 'created_at') AS tem_created,
       bool_or(column_name = 'event_id') AS tem_event,
       string_agg(column_name, ',' ORDER BY ordinal_position) FILTER (WHERE column_name IN ('status','status_visita','event_date','data_visita','due_date','completed','completed_at','expires_at','total_value','data_fechamento_venda','unit','lead_id','assigned_to','recurrence','start_time')) AS colunas_chave
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('company_events','pre_reservations','lead_visits','company_tasks','event_staff_entries','attendance_entries','maintenance_entries','party_monitoring_entries','event_info_entries','event_checklist_items','event_payments','generated_contracts','client_data_requests','freelancer_evaluations')
GROUP BY table_name ORDER BY table_name
